changelog: **The product name in copy and integrations comes from the organization brand (#2936):** the MARKETING overlay strings and the marketing landing's first FAQ question no longer spell out a product name; they carry the `{product}` placeholder the base dictionary already uses, and `applyVerticalOverlay(base, locale, vertical, { product })` fills it while merging (pages from the request brand, mail from the recipient organization, `llms.txt` from the host). Every former `productNameFor()` reader — page titles and share cards, the public header/footer/JSON-LD, sign-in/register/delete-account copy, both OpenAPI titles, the 2FA issuer, ICS files and feeds, Google Calendar sync, the meeting-room prefix and the meeting-invite attachment — now reads the brand resolver (`requestProductName`, `hostBrand`, `productNameForOrg`; the request-free half of `src/lib/hostBrand.ts` moved to `src/lib/orgBrand.ts`). `productNameFor()` remains only as the resolver's default, so output is unchanged until an organization carries a brand name. `check:i18n` accepts `{product}` as an overlay-filled placeholder.
